The '''House Paramexor Squire Armorer Droid''' was a model of [[armorer droid]] owned by [[House Paramexor]]. It was not available for public sale. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was intended to repair and customize a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter's]] gear; report information on the weaponry its owner could find; and serve as sentry to the hunter's mobile headquarters. The Squire had an [[IMR Module]] (Installation, Maintenance and Repair Module) to perform its tasks.
